name: Outdo
tagline: Once a year we come together from different corners of the world to go on a bikepacking adventure.
description: Friends, bikes, and the days that stay with us. Outdo is a growing journal of our bikepacking trips around the world.

headline: The days that
stay with us.
home.intro: Friends, bikes, and somewhere new. We make time to go. This is where we keep it.
home.storyTitle: For a while, life gets simple.
home.storyBody: One clear goal: get to the next place. In between, soak it all in. The nature, the people, the houses you pass. Just being outside, on your bike, away from the everyday.
home.storyAfterword: We come together from different corners of the world to do this. This journal is where we keep those days — to relive them, to get excited for the next ones, and to come back together in thirty years.
home.journalTitle: Some places become part of us.
home.journalDescription: The trips, as we remember them. Take your time.
home.notesDescription: Things we've learned along the way, for wherever we go next.
home.footerText: If this feels like your kind of thing, we'd love to hear from you.
home.memoryTitle: And then there are the evenings.
home.memoryBody: Laughing about the day we carried our bikes for five hours straight. Sitting outside a 7-Eleven, eating as much as humanly possible. Absolutely tired. Completely there.
home.memoryAfterword: These are the bits we keep talking about.
home.places: Japan. Slovenia. Britain. The Alps. And on we go.

faq.a: One or two trips a year, usually five to seven days each, somewhere none of us has ridden before.
Sometimes we take others with us. Email us and tell us a bit about your riding.

faq.q: How fit do I need to be?
faq.a: Comfortable with 60–90 km and 1,500 m of climbing per day, several days in a row. We ride together, not fast.
Small hotels and guesthouses. We carry our own kit but not tents.
Anything with 35 mm tyres or wider and low enough gears. Gravel bikes are ideal.

title: Different places.
Same friends.
about.intro: Outdo is our reason to get together, get outside, and spend a few days with nothing to do but ride.
about.peopleText: Coming together from different corners of the world, one trip at a time.
about.journalText: In thirty years, we want to sit around a fireplace together and go through the trips we did. The films, the photos, the routes. The things we thought we had forgotten. This is the start of that collection.
